name: CPJUMP1-A549-CRISPR-144h-130genes-1000views-v1
supersedes: cpjump1-960-views for the current user request; previous selections remain historical only.
plate_selection: BR00117004 has all 3456 sites; BR00117000 has all 384 wells and 3455 sites. Both have anomaly=none. Selected on metadata completeness, not phenotype outcomes.
selection: Retain every annotated treatment gene. Give each one distinct guide, then allocate 112 additional guides by fixed SHA256 rank, independent of expression, phenotype or UMAP. Select one well per reagent per plate; duplicate wells are not independent guides.

assembly.format: OME-TIFF with explicit axes and channel names
assembly.notes: Validate five unique matching channels; preserve raw values; never average to RGB or substitute missing channels. No image payloads downloaded or stacks built yet.

evaluation.primary: Cross-plate and cross-guide retrieval for held-out dual-guide genes, with same-guide cross-plate agreement reported separately.
evaluation.descriptive: After freezing settings, compute a 130x130 signed gene-profile similarity matrix and attach guide/plate concordance flags. Development genes remain marked as such; this all-gene matrix is not a fully held-out benchmark.
evaluation.aggregation: Aggregate cells to site, sites to well, then balance plate and guide contributions to gene profiles. Do not weight genes by cell count or treat sites/channels as experimental replicates.
evaluation.confidence: Single-guide genes retain two plate replicates but cannot supply independent-guide concordance. Similar morphology is not proof of shared gene function.

protocol: SSL trains only on development_train; tunes only on development_val; exclude evaluation_only before tool invocation. Keep the entire well together. This manifest is not a wired driver.
Batch calibration uses the 40 calibration guide identities and negative controls across both plates, not held-out gene labels. Technical batch is plate.
Two plates provide a small plate-effect test, not broad cross-lab robustness. Undetected batch effect or inadequate post-crop quality must result in a legitimate skip/abstain, not forced tuning.
A joint Harmony correction including unlabeled evaluation profiles is transductive and must be labeled as such.
Both plates share a layout. Same-guide cross-plate retrieval can exploit well-position effects; cross-guide comparisons and spatial controls are necessary.
144h is selected for consistency with Figure 2 and slightly higher published sister-guide retrieval, not a claim of uniformly stronger phenotypes or significant superiority to 96h.
Eight distinct NO_SITE control reagents per plate, four edge and four interior. No positive-control compounds or mixed perturbation modalities are included.
The historical two-plate selection and calibration/evaluation partitions are fixed before inspecting images or scores. Do not select or replace genes for more favorable test outcomes.
Different-gene biological similarity evaluation needs independent pathway/complex annotations and held-out scoring; same-gene guide agreement alone is not such ground truth.
